Help.caseParametersDesc: View ticket details, priority, and original description details.
Help.faqA1: You can customize your organization profile directly in Settings > General Settings. Note that modifications to the company name, industry, and default language require Owner role level access.
Help.faqA2: Go to Settings > Device Sessions. This shows all currently active devices, their IP address registers, and active tokens, along with a "Revoke Session" action to log out individual clients.
Help.faqA3: Go to Settings > AI Providers. You can configure credentials for OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google. Once connected, these keys are used by AI Agents to perform conversations across channels.
Help.faqA4: Edit or deploy your AI Agent in the AI Agents panel. Scroll to the "Business Hours" section, toggle operational hours, select your local timezone, and input start and end times for each day of the week.
Help.faqA5: Yes! Navigate to Channels Connect. You can link WhatsApp Business, Email, and SMS drivers. AI Agents can then target individual channels or broadcast templates to them simultaneously.
Help.faqA6: Message Templates are pre-approved content blocks used to start outbound conversations on channels (like WhatsApp). You can create them in the Templates view and use them inside Campaigns Broadcast.
Help.faqA7: Access Settings > Billing & Subscription. Here you can view your current plan details, next renewal date, and invoice logs. Owners can also access the Stripe billing portal to update payment credentials.
